children: UK property services provider's H1 revenue grew 3% yr/yr, driven by Surveying & Valuation
Adjusted diluted EPS for H1 rose 14% yr/yr
Company launched transformation programme and progressed £12 mln share buyback
LSL says trading since period end has been as anticipated and FY2026 expectations are on track
Company expects transformation programme to deliver at least £5 mln annualised benefit, building through 2027
LSL sees resilient market conditions and expects further profit increase for FY2026
TRANSFORMATION PROGRAMME - Co launched group-wide programme to simplify operations and deliver at least £5 mln annualised cost savings, with benefits expected to build through 2027
SURVEYING & VALUATION GROWTH - Division revenue rose 6% on allocation wins, improved contract terms, cost efficiencies and strong Asset Management performance
RESTRUCTURING AND COST CONTROL - Prior year restructuring and 8% reduction in central costs supported margin expansion and profit growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the real estate services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for LSL Property Services PLC is GBp360.50, about 44.2% above its September 14 closing price of GBp250.00
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
Sept 14 - Essar buys UK petrol station operator SGN Retail, adds 118 sites
Sept 14 - UK government seeks to acquire insolvent specialist steelmaker
